basic_info.description: Atop Mount Olympus, the geographical center of San Francisco, Upper Terrace is a quiet street with no outlet. Conveniently located with a 13 min walk to Cole Valley, The Castro and The Haight, it's a convenient 2 blocks to Buena Vista Park, Randall Museum and the dog park at Corona Heights. Sweeping views from downtown San Francisco to the San Mateo Bridge, the Bay, Mt Diablo and Twin Peaks.  Numerous nearby options for public transportation (37 bus and 33 bus). The best reason for owning and living at 259?: You get all of the above and a beautiful penthouse apartment with a 2 car side-by-side garage space that includes a subsidy of $6,100 per month in the form of rental income. Can't beat that.
